topics.title: Refresh mod list
topics.short: Re-reads every mod from Penumbra and re-classifies it. Nothing moves. Run it after installing, removing or moving mods elsewhere - nothing here updates on its own.

topics.title: Live events
topics.short: Penumbra events as they happen. Informational only: seeing a mod appear here does not re-scan, so run Refresh mod list yourself afterwards.

topics.title: Toggle protect all
topics.short: Protects every mod if any are unprotected, and unprotects them all otherwise. A protected mod keeps its current folder through every Sort and Apply.

topics.title: Toggle Heliosphere protection
topics.short: Protects or unprotects every Heliosphere-managed mod at once. Unprotecting lasts this session only - the next Scan re-protects them, since Heliosphere owns where they live.

topics.title: Protected folders
topics.short: Protecting a folder protects everything under it at any depth, including mods that land there later. Checking Gear also covers Gear/Feet and everything below it.

topics.title: Protected mods
topics.short: Protects one mod wherever it sits. A mod can also be protected by its folder or by Heliosphere - the note beside it says which, and those have no checkbox here.

topics.title: Protected by Heliosphere
topics.short: Protected because Heliosphere manages it, not by its own checkbox. Heliosphere owns where it lives, so the plugin never proposes moving it during Sort or Apply.

topics.title: Group by
topics.short: Chooses the folder structure proposed for every unprotected mod. Nothing moves until you press Apply on the Review Changes tab.

topics.title: Split gear by equipment slot
topics.short: Puts gear mods in Gear/Feet, Gear/Head and so on instead of a single Gear folder. Mods whose slot could not be identified stay in Gear.

topics.title: Split NPC mods by kind
topics.short: Puts NPC mods in NPC/NPCs, NPC/Bosses or NPC/Enemies. Turn it off to keep every NPC mod in one NPC folder.

topics.title: Sort
topics.short: Works out a new folder for every unprotected mod and shows it on the Review Changes tab. Your library is not touched until you apply it.

topics.title: Also use the NPC list scraped from the wiki
topics.short: Recognises far more character names, at the cost of matching some very common words. Turned off in this version while we confirm it is safe.

topics.title: Import Workbook
topics.short: Reads folder choices back from an exported spreadsheet, so you can plan a large reorganisation outside the game.

topics.title: Assign selected mods
topics.short: Sets the proposed folder for every checked mod. Unlike Sort, this does not renumber name clashes - it reports them as errors on Review Changes instead.

topics.title: Apply
topics.short: Writes every proposed path to Penumbra. This is the only control here that changes your library, and a backup snapshot is taken first, automatically.

topics.title: Export
topics.short: Writes the proposed changes to a text file you can read outside the game. Your library is not touched.

topics.title: Show Config File
topics.short: Opens the folder holding this plugin's own settings and data files. Changes nothing.

topics.title: Create Diagnostic Dump
topics.short: Writes a text file describing the plugin's current state, for troubleshooting or a bug report. Your library is not touched.

topics.title: Workbook destinations
topics.short: Which folder layout the exported spreadsheet should suggest. This affects only the exported file, not the proposed paths shown above.

topics.title: Export Workbook
topics.short: Writes every mod and its destination to a spreadsheet you can edit outside the game, then bring back with Import Workbook on the Sort tab.

topics.title: Protect & Skip All Blocking Mods
topics.short: Protects every mod named in the errors above so it stops blocking Apply. Those mods keep their current folder instead of moving.

topics.title: Re-read organization.json
topics.short: Re-reads Penumbra's folder file from disk to refresh the list below. If Penumbra has not written a change out yet, re-reading will not reveal it.

topics.title: Clean Up Selected Folders
topics.short: Removes the checked empty folder entries from Penumbra's folder file. No mod is touched. Run Rediscover Mods in Penumbra afterwards.

topics.title: Rollback Folder Cleanup
topics.short: Restores Penumbra's folder file from the backup taken before the last cleanup, undoing that cleanup only. No mod is moved.

topics.title: Create Backup
topics.short: Saves every mod's current folder as a snapshot you can return to later. Backups are also taken automatically before every Apply and Restore.

topics.title: Restore
topics.short: Moves every mod back to the folder it had in this snapshot. Exact: it moves protected and Heliosphere mods too, which Sort and Apply never do.

topics.title: Delete snapshot
topics.short: Deletes this backup permanently. Your mods are not touched - only the saved snapshot goes, and it cannot be recovered afterwards.

topics.title: Build/Refresh Index
topics.short: Reads every mod's changed items from Penumbra and builds the searchable index below. Read-only: it never moves, protects or alters a mod.

topics.title: Mod name contains
topics.short: Shows only mods whose name contains this text. It combines with the item filter and the category boxes - a mod has to satisfy all of them.

topics.title: Item contains
topics.short: Shows only mods that change an item whose name contains this text, such as one specific piece of gear.

topics.title: Categories
topics.short: Limits results to these mod categories. Unknown covers mods whose changed items the plugin could not classify.

topics.title: Slots
topics.short: Limits Gear results to these equipment slots. Unresolved covers gear whose slot could not be pinned to a single unambiguous match.

topics.title: Keep Current State
topics.short: Accepts whatever Penumbra has now as correct and unblocks the plugin. Nothing is moved or undone - the interrupted operation is simply closed.

topics.title: Continue
topics.short: Finishes the interrupted operation from where it stopped, moving the mods it had not reached yet.

topics.title: Restore Previous State
topics.short: Moves every mod back to where it was before the interrupted operation started, undoing the part of it that did complete.

topics.title: Keep Current State (one operation)
topics.short: Permanently abandons this one operation - it can never be continued or rolled back. The rest stay blocked, and one of them may then become resolvable on its own.

topics.title: Accept Current State and Close All Interrupted Operations
topics.short: Permanently abandons every interrupted operation at once. None can be continued or rolled back. No mod moves - it only stops the plugin blocking further actions.
